meta.name: Heart and Hustle Houston
meta.description: A sisterhood of successful Black women is redefining what it means to be a mother, wife and boss in Houston, Texas -- all while supporting each other.

videos.title: Makin' It Rain
videos.overview: At La'Torria's restaurant opening, the women hold nothing back. Alaina's troubled marriage gets dissected when Chloe pushes her to come clean about her pain. Chloe's younger man shocks the women and infuriates her son.

videos.title: The Good, The Bad and the Fine
videos.overview: Alaina shows Josh her new studio and they discuss the next steps to heal their marriage. Muneera reconnects with Norm. Chloe's memorial for Novia is upended by a no-show, and at the Rodeo, Alaina confronts Chloe about her comments at Rain.

videos.title: Very Cutesy, Very Demure
videos.overview: LeBrina treats some of the women to a day at her spa, Muneera confronts La'Torria, and Roe seeks therapy. At LeBrina's ranch, Alaina and Josh have an awkward moment when questioned about renewing their vows.

videos.title: Feels & Heals
videos.overview: Chloe and Jordan argue over Neiko. The ladies bond and support each other in a healing session with La'Torria's counselor. Feathers are ruffled when surprise guest Chiniqua shows up to Chloe's single ladies' night out with receipts.

videos.title: No New Friends
videos.overview: The ladies reel in the aftermath of the incident at MOCA. Roe's patience is tested when she agrees to meet with Chiniqua. Chloe attempts to mend things with Neiko. Alaina struggles to open up to her mother about her issues with Josh.

videos.title: Back in the Saddle
videos.overview: Roe's life takes a turn when she learns she might be pregnant. La'Torria addresses her grief, and starts her search for love. Muneera opens up to Alaina about her painful childhood.

videos.title: The End of An Era
videos.overview: Alaina confronts Josh about couples' therapy. LeBrina and Will have a breakthrough with Pop. Chloe tries to help Neiko with his music career. La'Torria has a special announcement at her Sweet 16 PR party.

videos.title: The Secret's Out
videos.overview: In a raw therapy session, Alaina reveals the secret betrayal that's haunted her and Josh's marriage. LeBrina hosts a girls' trip that takes the ladies down memory lane. Muneera and Alaina clash.
